title: Take out the trash: tie and remove an ordinary drawstring liner
instruction: Pull the liner's built-in drawtapes, tie them to secure the mouth, then lift the bag out and place it on the table without spilling.
context: Janitorial trash removal using an intact commercial factory drawtape liner. Development candidate: ordinary closure and robot feasibility are not yet verified.
setup: Reference: Brabantia PerfectFit Code A SKU 137600, 270 x 290 mm; matching Sort & Go 3 L bin SKU 137389, exterior 188 x 139 x 181 mm. Six clean polypropylene blocks, 48 x 80 x 35 mm, 25 g each. Two YAM arms on the existing table. PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md documents placement, reset and required measurements. Current diagnostic scene still has an idealised cylindrical bin and unverified tape dimensions/routing; it is not a validated product replica.
scoring: Development scorer: 0 for invalid evidence, escape or no cinch; 0.25 for retained cinch reaching <=50 mm and ending <=60 mm. Ordinary-knot verification is not implemented: all higher tiers and full success are withheld. Target full protocol is in PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md; it is not yet validated.
run_limit: 4,000 control steps at 20 Hz (200 simulated seconds); requested CLI seed 0, installed adapter environment seed 42, no object jitter.
reset_notes: Use a fresh intact factory liner with accessible factory tape openings, mouth >=100 mm, all six blocks inside, no pre-tie or added handles/locks. Clear the landing area. Complete the physical preflight before submission.
fidelity: Development: PhysX film; 80 articulated uniform tape links and symmetric hem sliding forces. No cord lock or added grip handles. Tape collision thickness is exaggerated; friction, routing and dimensions need sample verification. Current cylindrical bin differs from the specified commercial bin. Ordinary knot mechanics/evaluator are unvalidated. No object pose scripting or grasp attachment. Old scores/media do not apply.
scores: Revised scene: no completed full-score demo; no completed Dream-1 policy run.
